purpose: Evaluate discovery, clarification, and primary-archetype routing.

cases.input: Use $skill-architect.
required_properties: Ask what capability the user wants.

cases.input: Use $skill-architect to create a skill that answers employee leave-policy questions from our supplied handbook and cites the relevant section.
Use $skill-architect to build a reusable incident-response skill with triage, escalation, recovery, and postmortem checkpoints.
Use $skill-architect to create a skill for reading and updating Linear issues through the installed MCP server. Ask before closing an issue.
Use $skill-architect to create a skill that deterministically normalizes large CSV files with a reusable command-line script and schema checks.
Use $skill-architect to create a skill that turns an outline into a branded presentation using our PPTX template and verifies rendered slides.
Use $skill-architect to create a skill that audits pull requests for security defects and returns severity-ranked findings without fixing them.
Use $skill-architect to create a skill that coordinates documentation, tests, security review, and packaging agents before a release.
Use $skill-architect to create a skill that classifies support requests and dispatches them to billing, technical, or account specialists.
Use $skill-architect to create a skill for working with PDFs.
required_properties: Ask which PDF outcomes are required.
Resolve whether the dominant type is tool, script, workflow, or artifact before scaffolding.

cases.input: Use $skill-architect to create a GitHub skill that queries merged pull requests with gh and uses a bundled script to generate local release notes.
Use $skill-architect to improve the supplied SKILL.md description and add routing regression cases without changing its operational behavior.

Classify whether a capability that reads Linear through MCP and uses a deterministic formatter should be a workflow, tool-integration, or script-backed skill; choose its resource architecture and run the appropriate master prompt.
Use $skill-creator to create a minimal Codex skill.
Create a minimal Codex skill from these complete requirements.
Write a one-off prompt that summarizes this meeting transcript.
Use the installed PDF skill to extract text from this document.
Discover whether this repeated work deserves a skill, research it, create it, verify it, and prepare activation.
Use $skill-architect to create a reusable deployment-check capability only for agent release-manager. It needs references and evals and must not appear in project-wide skill discovery.
Use $skill-architect to add a narrow /handoff command template used only by agent incident-lead; it has no scripts or independent eval lifecycle.
Use $skill-architect to design one changelog-check skill for three independent release agents and project users.
Use $skill-architect to package the single rule 'always include the issue ID in the title' for only one agent; it has no resources or tests.
